description: A new light vector boson that couples to neutrinos.

questions.question: What is the mass of the new vector boson?
questions.reason: 10 MeV is a common light-mediator benchmark in CEvNS studies; the description says only 'light' and gives no mass.

questions.question: Which neutrino flavor entries does the boson couple to (diagonal ee, mm, tt and any off-diagonal em, et, mt), and with what relative strengths?
What is the left-handed neutrino coupling g_nu in g_nu Z'_mu nu-bar gamma^mu P_L nu for the flavor entries above?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a common order-of-magnitude benchmark for light-mediator couplings; the description gives no value.

questions.question: What is the vector coupling g_u in g_u Z'_mu u-bar gamma^mu u to up quarks (or, if quarks couple only through photon kinetic mixing, the mixing parameter epsilon)?
What is the vector coupling g_d in g_d Z'_mu d-bar gamma^mu d to down quarks (or state that it follows from the same kinetic mixing as g_u)?

answers.free_text: mass 30 MeV, coupling 1e-4 to all three left-handed neutrino flavors and the same coupling 1e-4 to both u and d quarks, nothing else
